result.title: What Entropy-Based View Selection Cannot See: An Audit of Test-Time Adaptation for Vision-Language Models
result.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshops on VLM4RWD
result.summary: Vision-language models such as CLIP can classify images into categories they were never explicitly trained to recognize, but accuracy degrades when test images differ in style or source from their training data. A common remedy generates randomly cropped and flipped copies of each test image, called views, and combines their predictions. Since some views miss the object, methods must identify which views to trust. The dominant approach uses prediction entropy to measure confidence and retains the most certain views. Other methods use signals such as embedding typicality. Despite repeated refinements of these scoring functions, the information they rely on, the model's own response to each view, remains largely unexamined. We investigate this choice while holding other pipeline stages fixed. First, we show that view selection, rather than the gradient update, accounts for almost all accuracy gains. We then examine whether entropy identifies useful views when predictions are wrong, despite at least one view predicting the correct class. In these cases, entropy ranks correct views above incorrect ones no better than chance, recovering only about one-twentieth of the accuracy recovered by an oracle over the same views. This finding holds across two image encoders and under a control ruling out an obvious statistical artifact. An exact analysis explains this limitation: entropy measures confidence but not which class a view favors. We identify an unused signal already available in the augmentation pipeline: the fraction of the original image retained by each crop. Ranking views by this quantity improves accuracy on 14 of 15 benchmark datasets over entropy and on 11 of 15 over the strongest scoring function tested. A pre-method measurement also predicts which datasets benefit.

AI.brief_summary: 论文审计 CLIP 等 VLM 测试时自适应中的视图选择：固定其余流程后发现增益几乎全来自选视图而非梯度更新，且当预测错误但存在正确视图时，熵对正确视图的排序接近随机；作者进而提出以裁剪保留原图比例作为新评分信号。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接涉及视觉证据筛选与支持组合：其「置信度不等于支持哪一类」的诊断可警示以 entropy 过滤 view/patch 的 LVR 设计，裁剪保留比例这一线索也值得核查其与视觉信息保真度的关系。
